summary: Vireo Growth Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its acquisition of all outstanding shares of FLUENT Corp. via a court-approved plan of arrangement under Ontario corporate law. Shareholders of FLUENT will receive 0.0705359 Vireo subordinate voting shares per FLUENT common share (a stock-for-stock consideration). The exchange ratio is equivalent to an implied price per FLUENT share; a premium is not explicitly stated. The board of FLUENT is subject to shareholder approval, while Vireo shareholders do not vote. The arrangement requires Ontario Superior Court approval; dissent rights exist. The transaction is an all-stock acquisition of a public target. Watch for shareholder vote timing, court hearings, and any rival bids or regulatory reviews given the cannabis industry context.
